name: Soken Chemical & Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Soken Chemical & Engineering Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells acrylic pressure-sensitive adhesives, functional polymers, organic fine particles, and adhesive tapes in Japan, China, and internationally. Its pressure-sensitive adhesives are used for a range of applications in industrial fields, including IT devices, automobiles, building materials, electronics and optical devices, and household products. The company's performance materials are used in the field of electronic substrate materials, inks, paints, displays, and multipurpose office equipment; and functional fine particles for use in LCD light diffusion agent, paint, toner, anti-blocking agent, cosmetic, and fiber reinforced plastic …
